name: bosi-programming-skills
description: Bosi's LLM skills: three-axis code review and the code-standards catalog it checks against, UML diagrams of a codebase or a description on a live, editable page, NFR docs written and reviewed against ISO/IEC 25010, an output-shape gate for summaries, an epistemic-action gate against predicting instead of checking, a phased recipe workflow from task to merged PR whose ticket evaluation, code planning and PR preparation also run alone, a sub-agent relay that runs that recipe hands-off, whose UI review, accessibility check and closing review and fix also run alone, a parent-issue orchestrator that runs it once per sub-issue, whose readiness gate, contract, bug reproduction, spike research with its questions answered behind a human gate, a design gate that stops a plan changing a schema, a migration or a public contract for a person, integration, QA, proof, review request and merge gate also run alone, and then integrates, QAs and merges them behind human gates, a line planner that suggests each ticket's line and saves it on the ticket, a work-session note writer, a feature planner that turns a feature into tickets, a pause step that saves half-done work as a task for tomorrow, a weekly review built from those notes, and a setup skill that writes the settings file the others read.

interface.shortDescription: Code review, standards, and a task-to-PR recipe
interface.longDescription: Multi-harness engineering skills. Three-axis code review renders its findings as a page; the code-standards catalog is the baseline it reads; uml draws UML diagrams of a repo or a description on a page you can edit; non-functional-requirements writes and reviews a project's NFRs against ISO/IEC 25010; summarize-llm-response and epistemic-action gate the model's own writing and reasoning; feature-recipe carries a task to a merged pull request in six phases, evaluate-ticket, plan-code, test, code, prepare-pr and code-docs run all six of its stages alone, recipe-relay runs it hands-off, assembly-line runs the stages a ticket's line names, plan-assembly-line is a line planner that suggests each ticket's line and saves it on the ticket, ui-review runs its UI review alone, a11y-check its accessibility check alone, security-review its security review alone and review-fix runs its closing review and fix alone, and open-restaurant runs it once per sub-issue of a parent, judge runs its readiness gate alone, contract its contract, reproduce its bug reproduction, integrate its integration, qa its QA and fix step, proof its proof step, review-request its review request and merge its merge gate, then integrates, QAs and merges them behind human gates; plan-work turns a feature into tickets, work-summary writes up a session as a dated note, pause-work saves half-done work as a task for tomorrow, weekly-planning fits the week's tickets around the calendar, week-summary turns a week of them into a review, and setup writes the settings file the others read their defaults from.
defaultPrompt: Run the feature recipe on this ticket.
